Asturian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Medieval Latin auctorizāre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /au̯toɾiˈθaɾ/ [au̯.t̪o.ɾiˈθaɾ]
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: au‧to‧ri‧zar

Verb

[edit]

autorizar (first-person singular indicative present autorizo, past participle autorizáu)

  1. to authorize
